hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *wq/config.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bad=''; for t in wq/test_wq_offline.py wq/test_wq_pipeline_offline.py wq/test_wq_fit_offline.py wq/test_wq_geo_offline.py; do /Users/rileysullivan/Coastal/.venv/bin/python "$t" >/tmp/wqhook.$$ 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then bad="$bad $t(exit $rc)"; fi; done; rm -f /tmp/wqhook.$$; if [ -n "$bad" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"wq/config.py was edited and these offline suites no longer pass:%s. An uncaught exception counts -- check the EXIT CODE, not the FAIL lines."}' "$bad"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"config.py edited - all four offline suites exit 0."}'; fi;; esac
